name: info-gathering
title: Gather prompt requirements, then write the prompt

origin.source: LangGraph prompt generation from user requirements (information gathering chatbot) tutorial

comparison.purpose: Asks the user for a prompt's objective, variables, constraints and requirements one question at a time, then writes the prompt template. The model only extracts what it heard; a choice state checks that all four slots are filled, always asks at least once (so an opener that fills every slot is confirmed before a prompt is written), and ends in failed after MAX_TURNS answers instead of trusting the model to decide when it has enough.

starters: I need a prompt that extracts invoice fields from emails
Help me write a prompt that summarizes support tickets for an on-call engineer
